name: Pull Request Review Brief
description: Example prompt that scopes a code review around intended behavior, risk areas, and evidence while avoiding style-only noise.

prompt.template: Review CHANGESET against INTENT. Focus on correctness, security, data loss, regressions, and missing tests in RISK_AREAS. Report only actionable findings supported by the diff, with file and line references. Treat PROJECT_RULES as binding and avoid style-only feedback.

variables.name: CHANGESET
variables.description: The pull request diff or commit range to review.

variables.name: INTENT
variables.description: The expected behavior and acceptance criteria.

variables.name: RISK_AREAS
variables.description: Components or failure modes that deserve extra attention.

usage.instructions: Supply the actual diff and acceptance criteria, then verify every reported finding against the checked-out source before posting review comments.
usage.example: INTENT: Preserve filters in the URL hash. RISK_AREAS: encoding, back navigation, unknown item ids.
